name: wordfreq 3.1.1, English large word list
author: Robyn Speer and the attributed source contributors

method.lookup: Exact casefolded headword lookup in get_frequency_dict; no token-product phrase estimates, lemmatization, synonym substitution or estimated missing values.
method.metric: Zipf = 9 + log10(proportion), rounded to 0.01 as quantized by the source. Higher means more frequent; ties have no additional frequency distinction.
method.unknown: Empty frequency_zipf and frequency_source; never zero or an invented score.
method.case: Casefolded spelling frequency. Known case/lemma-sense conflations IT, May, March and found are explicitly unscored; other values still do not distinguish senses or POS.
method.scope: Exact Oxford spellings only, excluding multiword/alternative forms, missing source forms and explicitly documented known conflations.

limitations: Frequency belongs to a spelling, not a particular meaning, grammatical part of speech, or inflectional lemma family.

General English aggregate across seven source domains: Wikipedia, subtitles (including freely available SUBTLEX data), news, books, web text, Twitter and Reddit; not a count specifically from American news.
Historical pinned snapshot; not real-time usage, learner usefulness, IELTS importance, or an Oxford frequency score.
wordfreq combines estimates from sources and rounds them. Decimal precision represents the source scale, not absolute accuracy or a claim to an exact corpus count.
modifications: Selected exact headwords present in the app, converted table proportions to the source Zipf scale, attached by stable app ID; no source text or full frequency table redistributed.

historicalExportNote: inputBeforeAttachingMetadata and outputAfterAttachingMetadata describe the original pinned frequency export, before later editorial corrections; currentCanonicalVocabulary identifies the current canonical TXT.

supplementalSourceReview.scope: Additive source-checked American spelling and list membership, targeted original meaning corrections and selected new senses; not a verification of every historical definition or publisher certification.

fullVocabularyReview.scope: Explicit selected meanings and original bilingual contexts reviewed against directly read source evidence. Historical word-list facts are preserved separately; this is not publisher certification or a claim to cover every sense.

essentialSenses.scope: Ordered additive essential-sense reviews; each batch retains its own baseline, source evidence and editorial scope.

reviews.scope: Append two directly source-reviewed foundational senses without replacing any existing spelling/POS/sense or stable ID. American facts identify exact homograph/POS; they do not certify authored Vietnamese translations.

CEFR labels follow the pinned American Oxford 3000 facts, not a separately assessed level for each selected dictionary sense.
